note: v475: Anything you log while reconciling now belongs to the account you're reconciling. The expense form's Bank account field pre-fills with that account instead of 'Any account' (so its categories load too), and the other ⋯ Record actions — invoice payment, income, owner move, gift card, loan payment, bill payment, reimbursement, prior-year entries — tag the record the same way. A record you'd already assigned to another account is left alone.
